name: 1.23.0-beta.40
notes: Ren'Py games: saves from the same game on another device, with Ren'Py Sync. In the game there (a phone, say), open Save or Load and press “Upload Sync”; it shows a code. Here, in the game's Saves (the list button), open “Saves from another device” and type the code. The saves come into the game and the app's Saves list.
“Send these saves to another device” does the opposite: the game shows a code to type in the other device's “Download Sync”.
The game still cannot reach the internet: only Ren'Py's sync server, and only through the app. Ren'Py Sync needs games made with Ren'Py 8.1 or newer.
